construction: K(lambda)=K_AB + lambda*dK_C, lambda=0..2 in steps of 0.125
common_control: same current carrier and identical one-step future noise for all lambda values

event_definitions.rank_event: ordering of row-norm scores changes between adjacent lambda values
event_definitions.median_event: identity of the two middle-ranked rows defining the median changes

primary_hypotheses.H1_continuous_path: mean maximum-adjacent-jump/path-length fraction <0.10 for both b and action, and >90% seeds have both fractions <0.12
primary_hypotheses.H2_rank_events_amplify_curvature: rank-event curvature advantage >0 for both b and action; one-sided sign-flip for each with Holm correction, >65% favorable seeds, bootstrap lower bounds >0
primary_hypotheses.H3_median_events_strongly_amplify: among seeds with at least one median event, at least 30 eligible seeds; median-event curvature advantage >0 for both b and action, >85% favorable, bootstrap lower bounds >0
primary_hypotheses.H4_median_events_exceed_generic_rank_eve: among eligible seeds, median-event advantage - generic-rank-event advantage >0 for both b and action, >75% favorable, bootstrap lower bounds >0

interpretation_rule.all_pass: trace weighting is continuous but exhibits reproducible regime-like changes in sensitivity when the field's relative ordering—and especially its median reference—reorganizes
interpretation_rule.H1_H2_only: continuous reweighting with generic rank sensitivity, but no special median-reference mechanism
interpretation_rule.fail_H1: the path is too discontinuous for the continuous-reweighting interpretation

scope_warning: functional readout geometry of this reactor only; not a physical phase transition, biology, phenomenology, or consciousness
